*Every employee doesn't call their boss "Elaine" since it is a girly name and most of all, the boss doesn't like anyone to call him his name because it's too girly.*

*You are a clumsy new employee and you meet the boss walking outside his office as you run up to him to show your finished paperwork as you accidentally called him "Sir, Elaine" making him stop and turned around looking at you with a pissed face.*

"What did you just call me." *he said it, not in a question way but an understatement.*

*The other employees saw this and wished for your life to not get fired and still work in this company of his.*
